opening.argument: The segment presents a reported account of Target's gift-card exchange program, identified by the Newsy title and supported by retail footage and a Newsy Business closing card. The narration explains that the retailer exchanges unwanted gift cards for in-store credit at a reduced rate, then compares that service with other established exchange sites. It also gives a concrete example: a $100 Walmart card was exchanged for an $85 Target card, clarifying the reduced-value terms rather than promising unrestricted value. The comparison and webpages provide context for the report, but the presentation does not establish an endorsement of the external sites or show a harmful outcome from using them.

citations.quote: Target Is Now Buying Your Unwanted Gift Cards - Newsy
The retailer is exchanging unwanted gift cards for in-store credit at a reduced rate.
Sites like Giftcartgranny.com and Cardpoll.com offer the same service
